---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a product capability or behavior change
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

Describe the user, context, and problem. Avoid prescribing an implementation in
this section.

## Desired outcome

Describe the observable result and how it improves the current workflow.

## Proposed acceptance criteria

```gherkin
GIVEN
WHEN
THEN
```

## Scope

Describe what belongs in the first coherent increment and what remains outside
it.

## Alternatives

Describe current workarounds and other approaches considered.

## Architecture and compatibility

Identify affected routes, APIs, data, migrations, accessibility, security, or
design-system contracts.

## Additional context

Link related requirements, detailed designs, screenshots, or prior discussion.

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing open and closed issues.
- [ ] This request describes a user problem and observable outcome.
- [ ] This request contains no security-sensitive or customer information.
